entities.summary: David Andrew Sitek is an American musician and record producer, known for his work with his band TV on the Radio and Yeah Yeah Yeahs. He has also worked with Liars, Foals, Celebration, Little Dragon, Wavves, Beady Eye, and Weezer, and produced free jazz-influenced remixes of songs by artists such as Beck and Nine Inch Nails, and has contributed a solo track to the Red Hot Organization Dark Was the Night charity compilation. He is also a photographer and painter.
